query:
SELECT 
  empresa_slug,
  COUNT(*) as total_lancamentos,
  SUM(valor) as total_valor,
  MIN(data) as primeiro_dia,
  MAX(data) as ultimo_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresa_slug = 'mascote'
  AND MONTH(data) = 3
  AND YEAR(data) = 2026
GROUP BY empresa_slug;
